description: S59 T6 (EV12): environment.teardown of an id the ledger does not hold is a refusal that names the id, carries the closed-set kind, and wrote NO row. Marking an unknown provision removed would launder a leaked container into 'nothing is running', which is the failure EV12 exists to prevent. fromSeam: the refusal is the STORE's sentence, carried verbatim by the door (DB19) — the walker stands a seam that answers with it.

error.message: the environment or secret-reference operation was refused

data.what: there is no provision prv_missing to mark — the ledger is the only thing that knows a resource exists, so a mark against nothing means the resource was created without a row (EV12)
data.means: the container, if it exists, has no ledger row — or the row was removed and something still runs
